name: Arducam Mini 2MP Plus SPI camera
description: An OV2640 camera with an 8 MB frame buffer and JPEG, controlled over SPI + I²C. Lets any MCU, even an Arduino Uno, capture 2 MP stills without a camera interface or PSRAM. Uses an M12 lens.

variants.note: 8-pin header (CS, MOSI, MISO, SCK, GND, VCC, SDA, SCL), M12 lens 60° horizontal

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: SPI is limited to 8 MHz, so real frame rates over SPI are far below the sensor's 15 fps at UXGA. Best for stills and slow streaming.
5 V and 3.3 V tolerant I/O. Draws 70 mA at 5 V, or 20 mA in low-power mode.

mcuNeeds.name: SPI camera (with frame buffer)
mcuNeeds.needs: an I²C bus, an SPI bus + chip-select
